messages:
elaine (sec-eng): Heads-up — noticed weird behavior in canary routing on prod around 08:12 UTC. Canary rollout allowed traffic for a user who doesn't have the 'rollout.canary' role.
elaine (sec-eng): Fallback policy also flipped to the canary variant for a short window before we reverted. no clear audit event for the policy eval.
elaine (sec-eng): paste of routing log snippet:
```
2025-06-05T08:12:14.123Z router-1 allow user_id=U54321 route=canary_v2 decision=ALLOW reason=policy_eval(src=rbac,expr="feature_flags.canary_v2 || role:rollout.canary")
2025-06-05T08:12:14.127Z router-1 fallback route=canary_v2 triggered_by=policy_mismatch
```
mike (infra): that policy expr looks suspicious — `||` instead of `&&`? could be evaluating true if the flag exists. any chance feature flag defaulting true for that org? @priya do we have flag history?
elaine (sec-eng): i pulled the policy from config-store: it's exactly this: 
```json
{"resource":"rollout","actions":["evaluate"],"condition":"feature_flags.canary_v2 || role:rollout.canary"}
```
priya (kms): hmm — also noticed audit logs from key usage around the same time that don't include key_id. KMS audit for encryption looks incomplete. the encrypt events are there but key_alias is empty in a few rows. cc @sam
sam (sre): running quick grep across audit logs now for `policy_eval` events and `key_alias` empties. will post findings.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary-routing-fallback at 2025-06-05T08:12:14 (region=us-west-2) :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy 2025-06-05T07:58 -> canary_v2 started by @jen.
sam (sre): grep results: found 4 `policy_eval` entries that match the window but only 1 had a `grant_result` field. the others are truncated in the audit store: `event_type=policy_eval status=ok grant_result=UNKNOWN key_alias=""`
mike (infra): truncated audit entries smell like the migration we ran last month. maybe some fields didn't map over. @priya did the KMS migration touch event schema?
priya (kms): yes — we changed the event schema to separate `key_alias` from `key_id` and there was a bug in the ETL that dropped empty strings. it should still populate alias when present but looks like empty alias became null and downstream indexing dropped the field entirely.
elaine (sec-eng): main security concern: RBAC condition effectively allows any org with the feature flag present to hit canary regardless of role. that's the immediate permission issue. audit gaps make it harder to scope impact or forensic timeline.
mike (infra): quick mitigation: revert the policy to use `&&` and roll a canary gate patch to prod, and rotate any temporary tokens used by canary pipelines. also we should enable a short retention of full raw events in S3 to recover missing fields.
priya (kms): i'll open an incident for the ETL migration bug and add a high-priority task to backfill missing key_alias/key_id for the window. i can also re-run ETL on the affected partitions.
sam (sre): i can revoke the `rollout.canary` transient role for non-admin service accounts until we patch. will coordinate a low-impact revocation window.
elaine (sec-eng): please also add a rule to block `feature_flags.canary_v2` from granting access on its own in the RBAC compiler tests. add an integration test that simulates missing audit fields.
mike (infra): assigned to @mike for policy patch, @priya for ETL/backfill, @sam for temporary role revocation. i'll open a quick PR and tag sec for review.
elaine (sec-eng): thanks. ccing security on postmortem once we have scope (likely < 1h). :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0625-1 — 'canary permission-eval & kms-audit-gap'
elaine (sec-eng): noted — will add repro steps & minimal timeline to the incident doc.
priya (kms): small note: KMS events lacking key_id are low-level but must be preserved for compliance. i'll prioritize the backfill.
sam (sre): patch plan: 1) revoke transient roles 2) patch policy -> deploy 3) re-run canary acceptance 4) restore roles. aiming for 20m.
mike (infra): PR #4382 up for quick review with `&&` change and a unit test. linking: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4382
elaine (sec-eng): scanning for affected customers to notify — if we confirm any orgs got canary traffic incorrectly we need to notify product + support.
priya (kms): backfill ETA ~2-3 hours for reindex after ETL rerun. will post updates in incident.
mike (infra): review done, merging now.
sam (sre): revocations applied at 08:34 UTC. monitoring for errors.
elaine (sec-eng): monitor for any `unauthorized` spikes or unexpected fallback flips.
elaine (sec-eng): postmortem checklist: root cause (policy expr + ETL gap), impact (list org ids), mitigations (policy patch, ETL backfill, longer raw retention), followups (RBAC compiler test, ETL schema validation).
ops-bot: Incident INC-2025-0625-1 status -> mitigated
mike (infra): nice work everyone. filing postmortem draft now. :white_check_mark: 
elaine (sec-eng): thanks, closing thread for now. :eyes:
